infoLinks.urlText: Trackwork may affect how you travel. Buses replace some trains between Springwood and Blacktown
infoLinks.content:
Friday 16 January 
  • The 18:56 Mount Victoria to Central, and the 19:24 Lithgow to Central services will end at Penrith. Change at Penrith for T1 Western Line trains to continue your journey.
  • The last direct train to the Blue Mountains leaves Central at 20:09, arriving Lithgow at 23:04.

  • From 9.50pm to 2am, buses replace trains between Springwood and Blacktown.
  • Trains run between Lithgow and Springwood, and T1 trains run between St Marys, Blacktown and the City, some to a changed timetable.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
1BM  Springwood, all stations to Penrith, Blacktown and return
60BM  Springwood, Penrith, Blacktown and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Service changes for Australia Day
infoLinks.content:
On Monday 26 January, ferries will be affected by exclusion zones on the Sydney Harbour from 11.45am to 12.45pm and from 7pm to 10pm while Australia Day events take place on the water. 
 
F8 Cockatoo Island services will not run to/from Circular Quay while exclusion zones are in effect. 
  • The 11.45am ferry from Circular Quay will depart from Barangaroo at 11.50am instead.  
  • Last ferries leave Circular Quay at 5.45pm and Cockatoo Island at 6.19pm.  
  • Additional late-night ferries leave Circular Quay at 10.05pm and 11.05pm and leave Cockatoo Island direct to Circular Quay 10.35pm and 11.35pm. 
For more details on additional transport services and changes, visit the Australia Day event page.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD diversions on Australia Day
infoLinks.content:
On Monday 26 January, route 202, 207 & 208 services will start and end trips at Wynyard Station due to road closures in place for Australia Day events.  
 
Services to the city will divert via Sydney Harbour Bridge York Street exit and end trips at Wynyard Station, York St, Stand N (200036). Stop Bridge St at Gresham St (200096) will be missed. 
 
Services travelling from the city will start trips from Wynyard Station, York St, Stand K (200033) and divert via Barrack Street and Clarence Street to return to route on the Sydney Harbour Bridge.  Stop Burns Philp Building, Bridge St (2000417) will be missed.  
 
Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations. For more details on additional transport services and changes, visit the Australia Day event page.

infoLinks.urlText: L2 Randwick and L3 Kingsford lines partial evening line closure for Australia Day events
infoLinks.content:
From 7:30pm to 10:30pm on Monday 26 January, L2 Randwick Line and L3 Kingsford Line light rail services will not run between Circular Quay and Town Hall, due to road closures in the city for Australia Day and for the safety of crowds. 
  • Use alternative transport including trains, metro or walking. 
  • L2 Line and L3 Line services will continue to run between Town Hall and Randwick or Juniors Kingsford as normal. 
  • Full L2 Line and L3 Line light rail services between Circular Quay and Randwick or Juniors Kingsford will resume running from 10.30pm until last service at 1am.
  • L1 Dulwich Hill Line light rail services will continue to run as per normal.  
All services will be very busy so be patient and allow plenty of extra travel time. 
 
For more details on additional transport services and changes, visit the Australia Day event page.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD diversions on Australia Day
infoLinks.content:
From 7.30pm until 10.30pm on Monday 26 January, route 304, 333, 343 & 396 services will start and end trips at Martin Place due to road closures in place for Australia Day events.  
 
Services travelling towards Circular Quay will end trips at Martin Place, Elizabeth St, Stand C (2000421). 
 
Services travelling away from the city will start trips from Martin Place, Elizabeth St, Stand E (2000283). 
 
Stops between Martin Place and Circular Quay will be missed in both directions. Check signs at stops, catch trains or continue on foot. 
 
For more details on additional transport services and changes, visit the Australia Day event page. 
 
Missed stops: 
  • Museum of Sydney, Phillip St (200059)  
  • Circular Quay, Young St, Stand D (200065) (333, 396 only) 
  • Circular Quay, Alfred St, Stand A (2000147) (304, 343 only) 
  • Circular Quay, Alfred St, Stand B (20002) (333, 396 only) 
  • Phillip St opp Museum of Sydney (200068)
infoLinks.subtitle: Sydney CBD diversions on Australia Day

infoLinks.urlText: Service changes for Australia Day
infoLinks.content:
On Monday 26 January, ferries will be affected by exclusion zones on the Sydney Harbour from 11.45am to 12.45pm and from 7pm to 10pm while Australia Day events take place on the water. 
 
F4 Pyrmont Bay services will not run to/from Circular Quay while exclusion zones are in effect. 
 
From 11.45am to 12.45pm, services will run between Milsons Point and Pyrmont via Barangaroo only.  
 
From 7pm to 10pm, services will not run. The last ferry from Circular Quay leaves at 6.42pm and the last ferry from Pyrmont leaves at 6.16pm.  
 
Services will resume with additional late-night ferries leaving Circular Quay at 10.12pm and 11.12pm, and Pyrmont at 10.41pm, 11.41pm. 
 
For more details on additional transport services and changes, visit the Australia Day event page.

From 11.45am to 12.45pm, services will run between Milsons Point and Pyrmont via Barangaroo only.  
 
From 7pm to 10pm, services will not run. The last ferry from Circular Quay leaves at 6.42pm and the last ferry from Pyrmont leaves at 6.16pm.  
 
Services will resume with additional late-night ferries leaving Circular Quay at 10.12pm and 11.12pm, and Pyrmont at 10.41pm, 11.41pm.

infoLinks.content:
From 12 January 2026, roadworks at Valla Beach Road will require buses on routes 358, 360 and 360X between Macksville, Coffs Harbour and Bellingen to divert.

The diversion will add time to all buses operating to/from Valla Beach. Some other timetables will also be adjusted due to this diversion.

No bus will depart earlier than its normal time.

The changes are expected to be in place for approximately two weeks.

Plan your trip for real-time up to date information.

  • 360 - Macksville to Park Beach Plaza via Nambucca Heads, Urunga & Toormina

infoLinks.urlText: T1 Western Line: Trains start and end at Central, platforms 1-14
infoLinks.content:
Monday 19 and Tuesday 20 January
  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 1.30am, trains run between T1 Western Line stations and Central, platforms 1-14 only.
  • For T1 North Shore Line stations use metro services to Victoria Cross, Crows Nest or Chatswood then change for replacement buses.

  • Nightly from 11.50pm to 4.10am, buses replace trains from Blacktown to Penrith, in that direction only.
  • Trains run from the City to Blacktown only.
  • The last train to Penrith leaves Central at 23:03, arriving Penrith at 00:20.

  • Tuesday and Wednesday, buses replace the 03:09 and 03:47 Emu Plains to the City trains from Emu Plains to Blacktown.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes

71T1 Blacktown, express to Penrith
72T1 Blacktown, all stations to Penrith
85T1 Emu Plains, all stations to Blacktown (limited service, in that direction only)
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

urlText: Alfred St at Lavender St, permanent bus stop relocation
content:
From 4am Sunday 6 April, bus stop Alfred St at Lavender St (206128) will be permanently relocated approximately 80m south of the current stop due to works for the Sydney Harbour Bridge Cycleway Northern Access Project. The newly relocated bus stop will keep the same bus stop name and ID.
 
Catch the following services from the relocated bus stop:
  • 150X – Manly
  • 154X – Dee Why
  • 203 – Castlecrag
  • 209 – East Lindfield
  • 230 – Mosman Wharf
  • 269 – North Sydney
  • 286 – Denistone East
  • 287 – Ryde
subtitle: Alfred St at Lavender St, permanent bus stop relocation

infoLinks.urlText: Service changes for Australia Day
infoLinks.content:
On Monday 26 January, ferries will be affected by exclusion zones on the Sydney Harbour from 11.45am to 12.45pm and from 7pm to 10pm while Australia Day events take place on the water. 
 
F10 Blackwattle Bay ferries will run to a public holiday timetable. The last ferry leaves Blackwattle Bay at 6pm and Barangaroo at 6.20pm. 
 
For more details on additional transport services and changes, visit the Australia Day event page.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD diversions on Australia Day
infoLinks.content:
From 10.30am until 1pm On Monday 26 January, route 230 services will start and end trips in North Sydney instead of Milsons Point due to road closures in place for Australia Day events.  

Services towards Millers Point will divert via the Pacific Highway and Blue Street to end trips at North Sydney Station, Blue St, Stand D (206014).  
 
Services to Mosman Wharf will start trips at North Sydney Station, Blue St, Stand D (206014). 
 
Stops between North Sydney and Milsons Point will be missed in both directions.  
 
Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations. For more details on additional transport services and changes, visit the Australia Day event page. 
 
Missed stops 
  • Miller St before Blue St (206024) 
  • Blues Point Rd before Lavender St (206031) 
  • Lavender St before Walker St (206057) 
  • Lavender St opp Cliff St (206058) 
  • Milsons Point Station, Alfred St Sth (206123) 
  • Broughton St at Pitt St (206125) 
  • Olympic Dr before Alfred St (206143) 
  • Milsons Point Wharf, Alfred St Sth (206120) 
  • Alfred St Sth opp Milsons Point Station (206121)

Stops between North Sydney and Milsons Point will be missed in both directions.

infoLinks.urlText: Service changes for Australia Day
infoLinks.content:
On Monday 26 January, ferries will be affected by exclusion zones on the Sydney Harbour from 11.45am to 12.45pm and from 7pm to 10pm while Australia Day events take place on the water. 
 
F5 Neutral Bay services will not run to/from Circular Quay while exclusion zones are in effect. 
 
From 11.45am to 12.45pm, services will run in a to/from Kirribilli only.  
 
From 7pm to 10pm, services will not run. The last service will leave Circular Quay at 6.25pm. 
 
Services will resume with additional late-night ferries leaving Circular Quay at 10pm and 10.30pm. 
 
For more details on additional transport services and changes, visit the Australia Day event page.

infoLinks.urlText: Change to Rutherford Technology High School bus services and pass requirements from 26 May
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 26 May, students travelling in the morning from the Rutherford and Aberglasslyn areas to Rutherford Technology High School are to use the 2712 service (operated by CDC NSW), instead of the S520 service (operated by Grace Coaches).

What's changing:
  • There is a slight timetable difference between the S520 and 2712, so please check TripPlanner to plan your journey.
  • Students on the 2712 service by CDC NSW will need an Opal card. If you don’t already have one, find out more about how to apply for a pass.
  • The 2712 will drop students closer to Rutherford Technology High School than the S520 previously did – arriving at Alexandra Ave after Weblands St (232097) at 08:32.

infoLinks.content:
Access to Bardwell Park Station is via temporary stairs on the eastern side of Hartill-Law Avenue to enable the demolition of the existing station stairs and construction of new stairs and a lift on the western side of Hartill-Law Avenue. Allow extra time to safely cross the road at the signalised pedestrian crossing at the corner of Hartill-Law Avenue and Slade Road.

Please also note that there are no public toilets available at this station until further notice.

infoLinks.urlText: Service changes for Australia Day
infoLinks.content:
On Monday 26 January, ferries will be affected by exclusion zones on the Sydney Harbour from 11.45am to 12.45pm and from 7pm to 10pm while Australia Day events take place on the water. 
 
F3 Parramatta River services will not run to/from Circular Quay while exclusion zones are in effect, services will use Barangaroo Wharf instead.  
 
In the evening: 
  • Last ferries leave Parramatta at 4.38pm to Circular Quay and 6.38pm to Barangaroo.  
  • Last ferries leave Olympic Park at 5.48pm to Circular Quay and 6.48pm to Barangaroo.  
  • Last ferries leave Circular Quay at 6.07pm to Parramatta and 6.37pm to Olympic Park.  
  • Additional late-night ferries to Olympic Park will leave Circular Quay at 10:07pm and 11:07pm. 
For more details on additional transport services and changes, visit the Australia Day event page.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction. Trains do not stop at Wolli Creek
infoLinks.content:
Wednesday 21 and Thursday 22 January  
  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction.
  • Trackwork buses do not leave from Martin Place Station, use metro services.
  • Most trains run to a changed timetable between Waterfall or Cronulla and the City Circle, with some making extra stops at St Peters and Erskineville.
  • Change at:
    • Sydenham or Central for metro services to Martin Place
    • Central for buses to Kings Cross and Edgecliff
    • Town Hall for express buses to Bondi Junction
  • Nightly from 10.10pm to 1.30am, trains do not stop at Wolli Creek but make an extra stop at Arncliffe.
  • Buses run between Sydenham, Wolli Creek and Arncliffe.
  • Change at Arncliffe or Sydenham for a bus to Wolli Creek or change at Central for a T8 Airport train if you have luggage or accessibility needs.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes

20T4 Bondi Junction, Edgecliff, Kings Cross, Central and return (bypassing Martin Place)
23T4 Bondi Junction, Town Hall and return
36T4 Arncliffe, Wolli Creek, Sydenham and return
324/325 City, Walsh Bay to Watsons Bay via Town Hall (Park St), Kings Cross, Edgecliff stations and return
333 City to Bondi Beach via Martin Place and Bondi Junction stations and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Maitland school buses - service changes
infoLinks.content:
From 27 January 2026, timetable and route path changes will take effect on some Maitland school bus services and regular route services.
 
Additional information:
  • A new route 2802 service will connect students directly from Maitland High School to High St Maitland, where it will become a new 185 service connecting students and the broader community to Lorn, Bolwarra, Bolwarra Heights and Largs.
  • An altered 1471 service will connect Maitland Christian School and Hunter Valley Grammar School students with Chisholm.
  • An altered 2396 service will replace route 0342 for Tenambit Public School students.
  • An altered 0342 service will no longer service Tenambit Public School and will now service Maitland Grossman High School students, getting students home to Metford earlier.
  • Additional weekend services for the 185 service – connecting Largs and Maitland via Bolwarra, Bolwarra Heights and Lorn.
Plan your trip for real-time up to date information.

infoLinks.urlText: Service changes for Australia Day
infoLinks.content:
On Monday 26 January, ferries will be affected by exclusion zones on the Sydney Harbour from 11.45am to 12.45pm and from 7pm to 10pm while Australia Day events take place on the water. 
 
From 11.45am to 12.45pm, F1 Manly ferries will not run. 
  • Circular Quay: the last ferry leaves at 11.40am; services resume at 12.45pm.
  • Manly: the last ferry leaves 11.15am; services resume at 12:30pm.
  • Catch a bus to travel between Manly and the City while services aren’t running. Additional route 170x services will run between Manly and Wynyard. 
From 7pm to 10pm, F1 Manly ferries will not stop at Circular Quay and will use Barangaroo Wharf instead. 
  • From Manly: The last ferry to Circular Quay leaves at 6.25pm; services leaving from 6.45pm to 9.20pm will end at Barangaroo. Services resume running to Circular Quay from 9.50pm. 
  • To Manly: The last ferry from Circular Quay leaves at 6.50pm; services from 7.10pm to 9.10pm will leave from Barangaroo. Services resume running from Circular Quay at 10.05pm. 
For more details on additional transport services and changes, visit the Australia Day event page.

infoLinks.urlText: The new Sydney Fish Market is opening Monday 19 January
infoLinks.content:
Wentworth Park is the closest light rail stop on the L1 Dulwich Hill Line, located approximately 400 metres from the new market.

Existing bus routes 389 and 501 serving Pyrmont and Ultimo will continue to provide access to the new Sydney Fish Market. These services operate along Harris Street and bus stops are just a 400 metre walk from the new Sydney Fish Market.

The Fish Markets light rail stop will be renamed Bank Street. From 19 January, visitors should disembark at Wentworth Park light rail stop.

Plan your trip at transportnsw.info

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace metro services between Tallawong and Chatswood. Use trains between Epping or Chatswood and Sydenham
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 24 and Sunday 25 January 
  • Metro services do not run between Tallawong and Sydenham. Testing is underway for Southwest Metro.
  • Buses replace services between Tallawong and Chatswood only.
  • For travel to and from Waterloo use local buses or trains from Redfern.

  • Trackwork also affects trains in the City. For travel between Epping or Chatswood and Sydenham use:
    • T9 trains between Epping and Central or T1 trains between Chatswood and Wynyard
    • L2 or L3 light rail services between Wynyard and Central
    • T4 trains between Martin Place and Sydenham.
Read more about weekend service changes in the City here.

infoLinks.urlText: Service changes for Australia Day
infoLinks.content:
On Monday 26 January, ferries will be affected by exclusion zones on the Sydney Harbour from 11.45am to 12.45pm and from 7pm to 10pm while Australia Day events take place on the water. 
 
F2 Taronga Zoo services will not run to/from Circular Quay while the morning exclusion zone is in effect.  
  • Circular Quay: the last ferry leaves at 11.32am; services resume at 12.52pm. 
  • Manly: the last ferry leaves 11.14am; services resume at 12.34pm. 
In the evening, services will run to a normal public holiday timetable with the last ferry leaving Circular Quay at 6.12pm, and the last ferry leaving Taronga Zoo at 6.27pm.  
 
For more details on additional transport services and changes, visit the Australia Day event page.

infoLinks.urlText: Service changes for Australia Day
infoLinks.content:
On Monday 26 January, ferries will be affected by exclusion zones on the Sydney Harbour from 11.45am to 12.45pm and from 7pm to 10pm while Australia Day events take place on the water. 
 
F6 Mosman Bay services will not run to/from Circular Quay while exclusion zones are in effect. 
  • The 12pm ferry from Circular Quay will depart from Cremorne Point at 12.10pm instead. 
  • Last ferries leave Circular Quay at 6pm and Mosman Bay at 6.25pm.  
  • Additional late-night ferries leave Circular Quay at 10pm and 11pm and Mosman Bay at 10.22pm and 11.22pm. 
For more details on additional transport services and changes, visit the Australia Day event page.

urlText: Tamworth Country Music Festival bus timetable changes and diversions
content:
Friday 16 to Sunday 25 January
  • Route 428, 430, 431, 433, 435, 436, 443 and 444 services will run to the Country Music Festival event timetable. 
  • Stops in Kable Avenue and White Street will be missed due to festival road closures. All services will depart from Brisbane Street between Peel Street and Kable Avenue.
Stops affected:
  • Tamworth, The Atrium Shopping Centre, Kable Ave (23401530)
  • Tamworth, The Atrium Shopping Centre, Kable Ave (234079)
  • Tamworth, White St at Peel St (234081)
